mapper.sql: e.expense_id, e.user_id, e.title, e.status, e.total_amount, e.submitted_at, e.version, u.user_id AS applicant_user_id, u.user_name AS applicant_user_name, u.email AS applicant_email, u.dept_id AS applicant_dept_id, u.position_id AS applicant_position_id, u.role AS applicant_role, d.dept_name AS applicant_dept_name, p.position_name AS applicant_position_name, p.rank_level AS applicant_rank_level
INNER JOIN users u ON e.user_id = u.user_id INNER JOIN departments d ON u.dept_id = d.dept_id INNER JOIN positions p ON u.position_id = p.position_id

LEFT JOIN expense_details ed ON e.expense_id = ed.expense_id LEFT JOIN expense_categories c ON ed.category_id = c.category_id LEFT JOIN tax_rates t ON ed.tax_id = t.tax_id LEFT JOIN receipt_images ri ON e.expense_id = ri.expense_id LEFT JOIN approval_histories ah ON e.expense_id = ah.expense_id LEFT JOIN users ah_u ON ah.approver_user_id = ah_u.user_id
ORDER BY ed.detail_id, ri.uploaded_at, ri.image_id, ah.created_at, ah.history_id
